themes.name: Cyberpunk
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Neon magenta and cyan on near-black in both modes — there is no daylight side: sharp corners, mono, uppercase headings, glitch on entry.
themes.descriptionZh: 近黑底上的霓虹洋红与青，两种模式都是夜：尖角、等宽、标题全大写，入场带一点故障感。

themes.name: Doodle
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Warm paper with a crayon-orange accent, 2px outlines at a hand-drawn weight, and a bouncy ease.
themes.descriptionZh: 暖纸底配蜡笔橙，2px 手绘粗细的描边，动效带点弹。

themes.name: Clay Glow
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Warm paper canvas with a terracotta accent: a warm editorial light side, and a warm near-black dark side.
themes.descriptionZh: 暖纸底配陶土强调：浅色是暖调纸面，深色是暖近黑配铜橙强调。

themes.name: Skeuomorphic
themes.author: lmliheng
themes.description: Warm paper and canvas with bevels: every raised thing has a highlight along its top and a shadow under it, and menus are frosted.
themes.descriptionZh: 暖纸与帆布质感配斜面：每个凸起的东西上面一道亮线、下面一层投影，菜单带磨砂。
